title: Berserker
author: Kshatriya Strength
desc: Designed for seasoned athletes, this advanced hypertrophy training mesocycle is the ultimate challenge for those committed to pushing their boundaries.

ex.note: Perform the movement with the rear foot elevated.

Perform the movement with the middle grip.

Perform the movement with one arm, keeping your non pulling shoulder in contact with the pad.

Perform the movement with an EZ Bar using the closest grip.
Perform the movement standing using a cable.
Perform the movement with eight reps per leg.
